sub: One small cute deep-sea research submarine seen exactly from the side, facing to the RIGHT: a short, fat, rounded white hull (#F4F4F0 with a pale-grey #D5D5CE shade along the bottom), shaped like a plump capsule about twice as long as it is tall; on top of the hull, a little behind the middle, a tall narrow bright-orange conning tower (#F08A24 with a darker #C96A12 shade on the left) with a flat top; on the very top of the tower a round open hatch, its round lid flipped open and standing upright on the left edge of the hatch; one big round porthole window on the front right of the hull with dark-blue glass (#1F4E79), a white glint and a thick black rim; two small round lights on the front nose; a small black three-blade propeller at the back on the left; a few simple rivets. No face, no eyes, no text, no numbers, no people, no water, no cables. Whole submarine in frame with a margin. sea: A very simple calm ocean seen exactly from the side, like a school diagram. A clear light-blue sky (#9ED3F0) with two small simple white clouds fills the top 55 %. The bottom 45 % is calm deep-blue sea (#2F7FC4) with a few short white wave lines; the water's top edge is a straight horizontal line at 55 % of the height. On the LEFT 40 % sits the back end of a small white research ship seen from the side: a white hull (#F2F2EE) with a dark-blue stripe (#1F4E79) floating on the water, a flat deck at 47 % of the height with a simple thin railing, and a tall bright-yellow crane arm (#F2C230) that leans out from the deck over the open water to the right, ending in a small black pulley wheel at about 62 % of the width and 18 % of the height. Nothing hangs from the crane. No people, no text, no numbers, no flags, no birds, no other ships.
